title: VIBE: Annotation-Free Video-to-Text Information Bottleneck Evaluation for TL;DR

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing evaluation scores (grounding and utility) across Vision-Language Models (VLMs) of varying sizes and sources (e.g., QwenVL vs. InternVL variants) to assess the metric's robustness against statistical biases introduced by specific VLM training data and conditional probability modeling assumptions.
